title: Bomb fruit
body:
Description

Bomb fruit is a fruit that was added in Halloween event 2025. It works like a bomb and ignites itself when the tree that this fruit is on is chopped. It grows on Corrupted palm and Halloweenly.

How to Obtain:

Don't chop the tree with that fruit, because it will explode.

  1. First you need to climb on tree (it will be easier with Gravity Coil or Fusion Coil)
  2. Then collect the fruit and drop it.
  3. Go down and collect the fruit.

Uses

There is a button "Ignite" so you can:

  1. You can use it like simple bombs. So try to detonate walls in caves
  2. You can also try to kill some monsters in Acidlands or Halloween monsters while blood moon
  3. It can be used to chop trees or mining ores in caves
  4. You can also use it as decorations
